title: What was the best bit?
setting: A day at the museum · Level 2

n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: Shh. Look — they're both asleep. Five hours of dinosaurs. Best babysitter in London, that museum.

translations.fa: هیس. ببین — هر دوشون خوابن. پنج ساعت دایناسور. بهترین پرستار بچهٔ لندن، اون موزه.

branches.suggestion: They're so sweet when they sleep.

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: So, what was the best bit for you?

translations.fa: خب، بهترین قسمتش برای تو چی بود؟

branches.suggestion: The best bit was the earthquake room.
I enjoyed the gems and crystals.
branches.suggestionFa: از جواهرات و کریستال‌ها لذت بردم.

recasts.better: The best bit was the earthquake room.

n3.speaker: tom
n3.text: The earthquake room! The supermarket one that shakes. Do you get earthquakes in Iran?

translations.fa: اتاق زلزله! همون سوپرمارکتی که تکون می‌خوره. تو ایران زلزله میاد؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, sometimes. Tehran is near a fault line.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، گاهی. تهران نزدیک یه گسله.

branches.suggestion: Yes. So the room felt very real to me.
branches.suggestionFa: آره. برای همین اون اتاق برام خیلی واقعی بود.

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: Wow. I didn't know that. What surprised you most today?

translations.fa: واو. نمی‌دونستم. امروز چی بیشتر از همه غافلگیرت کرد؟

branches.suggestion: I didn't expect it to be free!
I didn't expect so many people!

cultureNote.en: "I didn't expect…" is a useful way to talk about surprises: "I didn't expect it to be so big."
cultureNote.fa: I didn't expect برای گفتن غافلگیری به کار می‌رود.

n5.speaker: tom
n5.text: Free, and full of history. In Iran, are there big museums too?

translations.fa: مجانی، و پر از تاریخ. تو ایران هم موزه‌های بزرگ هست؟

branches.suggestion: Yes! The National Museum in Tehran is amazing.
Yes, and in Isfahan the whole city is like a museum.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، و تو اصفهان کل شهر مثل موزه‌ست.

n6.speaker: tom
n6.text: The whole city? I'd love to see that one day. You can be our guide!

translations.fa: کل شهر؟ دوست دارم یه روز ببینمش. تو می‌تونی راهنمامون باشی!

branches.suggestion: I'd love that! You'd all love Isfahan.
branches.suggestionFa: خیلی دوست دارم! همه‌تون عاشق اصفهان میشید.

branches.suggestion: Deal. But no dinosaurs in Isfahan!
branches.suggestionFa: قبول. ولی تو اصفهان دایناسور نیست!

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: No dinosaurs? Then Nicola's not coming. Ha! Shh, next stop is ours. You take William, I'll take Nicola. Gently…

translations.fa: دایناسور نیست؟ پس نیکولا نمیاد. ها! هیس، ایستگاه بعدی مال ماست. تو ویلیام را بغل کن، من نیکولا را. آروم…
